Strikt. One chat, no settings.

strings.key.needed:
The coach runs on your own Anthropic key. Strikt is free, Anthropic bills the key for what it spends.

- console.anthropic.com, sign in
- Billing, put a few dollars on the account
- Settings, API keys, Create key. It starts with sk-ant-
- paste the key here

I check it, store it encrypted and delete your message.

strings.bot.short: A coach in one chat. Send food, get the number. The day ends with a verdict.
strings.bot.description: Strikt logs food, training, sleep and measurements from one Telegram chat. Send a photo, a screenshot, a voice note or text; the reply is kcal, protein, carbs, fat and fiber per item, the day so far and what is left. The Today card stays pinned and is edited in place. When you go quiet it writes first: the fact, then the pattern from your own data, then an instruction with a deadline. The day closes with a verdict. No greetings, no emoji, no praise. Invite-only.

strings.mfp.page.title: Connect MyFitnessPal
strings.mfp.page.steps:
1. On a computer, open myfitnesspal.com in Chrome and log in.
2. Press F12 (on a Mac: Cmd+Option+I), open the Network tab and reload the page.
3. Right-click the first request (www.myfitnesspal.com): Copy, then Copy as cURL (on Windows: Copy as cURL (bash)).
4. Paste it below and press the button.
Only the login cookies are kept, encrypted, and only to write your food diary.
